profile.summary: wraithgar is a highly experienced JavaScript reviewer with deep expertise in Node.js and npm CLI internals. Their reviews demonstrate strong command of asynchronous programming, CLI tooling, and package management, with a focus on ensuring behavioral consistency, backward compatibility, and proper error handling. While their primary specialization lies in backend JavaScript (Node.js/npm ecosystem), their understanding of JavaScript runtime behaviors and modern ES6+ features suggests a broader mastery of the language. The reviewer excels in evaluating CLI tooling, dependency management, and asynchronous workflows but shows no evidence of frontend framework expertise or TypeScript usage. Their contributions emphasize security awareness, documentation clarity, and modern JavaScript practices like Promise-based APIs and modular design.
